crossRefs.note: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.

translations.web: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”
translations.bsb: His disciples remembered that it is written: “Zeal for Your house will consume Me.”
translations.kjv: And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of thine house hath eaten me up.
translations.asv: His disciples remembered that it was written, Zeal for thy house shall eat me up.
